  (∀ (j : Fin p), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (A j) = 1) →

      RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairTupleAngle A α *

            (RectangleCLT.Companion.weightedScore (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) id fun g =>

            4 * RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairTupleEntropy s (σ • A) A (fun x => v) α () -
          RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairTupleRadialTrace s (σ • A) A (fun x => v) α ()

passages.claim: Every original angle-weighted tuple reference has actual averaged mass at most 2pi C0 h²κ/sigma, and the full reference family is counted by cardFace^(K+2).
passages.method_variation: The original Gaussian projections are transported through the checked native product law; zero-angle pairs vanish exactly. Actual base and Gaussian integrability/Fubini are proved.
